Hero_Desc_Arco:
A Grape Elemental street dancer whose passion for dance is second to none.
She idolizes Festa, who cared for her when she was still a grape, and works every day to become the greatest dancer.
Her personality is always as bright and passionate as her dancing.
Album_Hate_Arco: Fake fruit juice, places where silence is required
Album_Hobby_Arco: Choreographing dances while listening to Festa's new songs
Album_Wish_Arco: To be recognized by everyone as the greatest dancer
Album_Arco1: Arco is a Grape Elemental who loves to dance. She especially loves dancing to Festa's music... She seems to have rather unusual musical taste.
Album_Arco2: Meluna treats Arco well, regarding her as something like her own junior. Perhaps because they share a love of fruit and music, Arco looks up to Meluna as well. Maybe we will get to see them perform together someday.
Album_Arco3: Arco's homemade fruit juice is wonderfully fresh and delicious, but it may be a little dangerous. Whenever I drink it, I feel an urge to dance wildly that I never experience otherwise. After repeatedly finding myself unable to contain the excitement and dancing alongside Arco, I have stopped touching her juice.
Album_Arco4: Whether she is alone, with one other person, or in a crowd, Arco dances without a care. Be warned: if you do not keep her rhythm by clapping or dancing along, she will declare that you have ruined the mood and charge at you, trying to make you drink her fruit juice.
Album_Arco5: Arco possesses an extraordinary palate when it comes to fruit juice. During a blind tasting, she correctly identified every fruit in each juice and the exact proportions used. She is not called a 'fruit juice sommelier' for nothing.
Album_Arco6: Arco confessed that she once tried to force Sylla, Ifrit, and Gabia to learn dancing, only to be scolded and fail. She looked dejected as she recalled that day, but soon reignited her passion, declaring that she would overcome this obstacle and hold an 'Elemental Dance Battle' someday. Will Arco's dream ever come true...?
Album_Arco7: When I asked Arco what she did when she was neither dancing nor making fruit juice, she wore a serious expression and began thinking. Then she said she had a dance for when she was thinking and immediately started dancing. It seems I will not be getting an answer to that question.
LoveHero_Arco: All right, let us set the stage ablaze. Drop the beat!
LoveHeroCancel_Arco: Tired already? The heat of the stage has not even faded yet...!
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Hate1: She insisted that someone as full of rebellious spirit as herself could never eat food this bland and oppressive. Is she imitating Festa?
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Hate2: She recoiled from it as a boring drink that leaves her listless and wanting only to sleep. Is that not the point of drinking tea...?
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like1: She guzzled it down, saying grape juice was practically her life force. Is it all right to drink that much? She is a Grape Elemental, so surely it is fine.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like2: She says it tastes like energy literally exploding. Like herself after an intense dance, apparently.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like3: She eagerly shoveled it down, praising its chewy texture. In her rush to feel the food's passion before it cooled, she seems to have burned her tongue.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like4: Her eyes lit up after one bite, and she asked about staging a dance performance themed around Christmas carols. I advised her not to do it in Monatium.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like5: Apparently, she once entered a UCC contest for the Vita series. Declaring that she would demonstrate her performance, she tossed it into her mouth and started dancing... Her energy truly is incredible.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like6: She seems to like the purple songpyeon. She said grape flavor would make it hip and tried to pour grape juice over it. Stopping her was quite a struggle.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like7: She said you naturally crave something sweet after dancing your heart out, and took several with her as a possible substitute for grape juice.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like8: Apparently, she once entered a UCC contest for the Vita series. Declaring that she would demonstrate her performance, she flung the powder into the air and started dancing... Her energy truly is incredible.
Food_ChefNote_Arco_Like9: As she gazed at the container of colorful, sparkling candies, she became sentimental and said that she and her dance crew must be shining in their own colors just like them.

LoveLetter_Arco:
Hello, Master! I wanted to make sure I thanked you for everything you have done for me. You helped me so much both when I was imprisoned in Monatium and when you took charge of our idol group as its manager. Thank you!

Now I respect you just as much as I respect Festa! If you ever need me, or if you plan to throw a party, call me anytime. I will put my whole heart into making it a success! Until then, this has been Arco, always dancing with all her might and rebelling with all her might!
LoveCall_Arco:
Master, how have you been? It is Arco!
I am always stepping to a cheerful beat on the streets of Monatium.
These days, everyone recognizes me and cheers me on, so every day has been wonderful.
Ah! Today's performance was a success too!
There really is nothing I enjoy more than dancing.

Lately, when I listen to Festa's music, I often find myself thinking of you, Master.
I do not know why, but it makes me happy.
Um, are you interested in dancing, Master? I am really good at teaching it...
I hope we can stand onstage and dance together someday!
Until that day, today is dance time too! Let's party! I will visit soon, so dance with me!
